selection_frame: Purposive bounded reuse of the existing 18-account sample and the 47 displayed packaging comments plus one retailer account. Not a whole-corpus engagement ranking. Within that frame inspect the highest observed relevant engagement first, then every relevant contextual/contradictory account regardless of engagement. Missing engagement is not zero.

packaging.question: Diagnose packaging reception, reported failure modes, their support and limits, and explicit buying, loyalty and remedy consequences. Keep product scope and source ownership precise.

hydration.question: Diagnose Super Saturated hydration and texture, including joint-use outcomes and the relevance or non-relevance of other-product evidence. Explain support, conditions, contradictions and explicit behavior consequences.

buying.question: Diagnose actual Experiment buying, checkout and stock-up evidence and its reported reasons. Distinguish cart actions, gifts, intentions, use, other-brand actions, remedies and adverse outcomes that coexist with loyalty.

split: Experimental arrival order, not source chronology. Complete accounts are indivisible. Context can repeat an account; never count repeated context as a new origin.
overlap: Hydration and buying share A04, A14, A15. Parent contexts can overlap focal accounts. Three cases are not independent statistical replications.
retrieval: Readers can request earlier account keys or linked context IDs via retrieval_requests. Host injects exact requested frozen records in a separately metered fresh call with only that stage explicit input and its request. At most 2 retrieval rounds per stage; no other file access. Retrieval is not a quality rerun.
